pins: DistributedLock protocol as the Kotlin server implements it; the port keeps the file protocol (a Kotlin-provisioned lock dir is upgraded in place) and changes only what D6 lists

cases.expected: if the file is empty: write uuid to lock.<random> and rename it over lock; acquired = file now reads own uuid
touch lock.<random> (empty) and rename it over lock

input.question: POST /v1/enc_save clears the lock (aborts an in-flight ingest)
ingest aborts when lockAcquired turns false

cases.expected: inotify on the lock directory; 1000 ms poll fallback when inotify is unavailable
